title: What Would Standing on Saturn's Moon Titan Feel Like?

notes.text: tags set to search phrases and language to en-GB (J2504)

Nothing technically wrong (J2501, review merged as #738). Tags to search phrases and language to en-GB: J2504. No re-cut or second upload. The opening gate had no full-bleed check and passed this Short's blur-padded 16:9 opening: J2505 adds the check and runs it on every scheduled Short. Also found: the live Mars Short iyvWYFP_ETA had no Related video; J2504 sets it on all four Mars Shorts.

At 6 hours: nothing is broken. It is public, in HD, with no restrictions, and the listing matches what was approved. It has 17 views where 240 is usual, because YouTube has shown it to very few people. That points at the subject, not the edit: our four earlier Shorts with Saturn in the title also started slowly. No re-cut and no new upload. We will not plan another Saturn Short for the next four weeks. The Titan film on 25 Nov stays where it is; its Shorts get titles that lead with what you would feel there, not with the word Saturn. Next look: tomorrow morning's numbers.
